name: NG exhaustion D1-D5 predictability timing grid
objective: For each preserved exact D1-D5 chain/behavior, find the earliest causal moment the already-defined behavior becomes predictably callable: prior to target onset, at target detector confirmation, or at the first validating post-detection H checkpoint.

prior_rule.rule_ready: max(predecessor_ready for every predecessor required by the D-depth rule)

post_detection_rule.checkpoint_information: information causal by target detector confirmation + H plus survival-to-H only

search_sequence: eligible PRIOR H values in ascending order -> +0 target detector confirmation -> +1 -> +2 -> +3 -> +4 -> +5 -> +10 -> +15 -> +20 -> +25 -> ... -> +3600

D1.prior: test origin/predecessor information at every active H; PRIOR means before the D1 target descendant t0

D2.prior: all required predecessor information for the D2 rule must be causal at tested H before target t0

D3.prior: all required predecessor information for the D3 rule must be causal at tested H before target t0

D4.prior: all required predecessor information for the D4 rule must be causal at tested H before target t0
D4.post_detection: same active H grid; low support preserved

D5.prior: all required predecessor information for the D5 rule must be causal at tested H before target t0
D5.post_detection: same active H grid; n=1 case only

historical_h5_availability_reference_not.note: Reference only. Does not authorize skipping H=1,2,3,4 and does not prove skill at H=5.

do_not_use: realized final duration at an earlier checkpoint
realized final D depth at an earlier checkpoint
later signed-direction Lane 3/4 detour or subsequent reframing as program authority
